summary: Frontend-only regression + feature test of the Six Outcomes framework and logo lockup additions on Home.jsx and System.jsx. All planned features verified working correctly via code review + Playwright automation. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: site.js SIX_OUTCOMES and SYSTEM_GOAL_STATEMENT exports are clean, well-commented, and properly reused by both Home.jsx and System.jsx - good DRY practice.
Outcome tag pills on System.jsx use rounded-full + border pattern consistent with existing xoFit tab pills - visually native, no inconsistency.
Both logo images (956x344) have explicit width/height attrs on all usages (Home hero, System hero light+dark variants) - no CLS risk introduced.
No console errors observed on Home, System, or Contact pages during testing.
test_credentials: Not required for this test scope
seed_data_creation: None - no test data created, no HubSpot leads submitted (smoke check only verified field presence, did not submit).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All items from the 'NOT yet independently verified' list in agent_to_agent_context_note have now been verified: (1) dark-theme toggle on System page hero logo - confirmed correct swap (light logo hidden, dark/white logo visible, html gets 'dark' class); (2) fit/finish steps' outcome tags - confirmed exact text 'Patient Experience'+'Time' for fit and 'Profitability'+'Practice Growth' for finish via data-testid selectors; (3) sidebar anchor click-to-scroll for 'outcomes' anchor - confirmed working on both Home (scrolled to #outcomes, url unchanged since it's a JS scroll not hash nav) and System page; (4) full regression sweep - all existing data-testid elements (hero, home-component-*, home-system-link, system-link-*) present and section eyebrows correctly renumbered (Home: 04 outcomes, 05 proof). Contact page smoke check passed (all 8 fields present, no errors). No bugs found this iteration.
